title: QL-Hub
description: A modern, lightweight, and smart /hub command for BungeeCord and Velocity with background ping-checking and load-balancing.
body:
# 🧭 QL-HubCommand **A simple, lightweight, and smart /hub command for BungeeCord and Velocity.** [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/VERSION-1.0.0-00A8E8?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ql-hubcommand) [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/PROXY-BUNGEECORD%20%7C%20VELOCITY-F4C300?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ql-hubcommand) [![Performance](https://img.shields.io/badge/PERFORMANCE-HIGH--SPEED-FF3B30?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ql-hubcommand) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/DISCORD-SUPPORT-7289DA?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord)](https://discord.com/invite/ZRe3RnubdW)
--- ## ✨ What is QL-HubCommand? **QL-HubCommand** is a modern and highly optimized proxy-side plugin designed to route players to your hub or lobby servers seamlessly. It works on both **BungeeCord** and **Velocity**, providing smart load-balancing to distribute players to the least populated hub. It also includes an active background checker to ensure players are never sent to an offline server. > 💡 **IMPORTANT:** > **Built for modern networks:** Compatible with any Java 17+ environment and natively supports both legacy color codes and Velocity's modern MiniMessage format. --- ## 🚀 Key Features * ⚡ **Smart Balancing:** Automatically sends players to the hub server with the lowest player count. * 🛡️ **Ping Checker:** Verifies hub servers in the background and ignores offline servers during balancing. * 🍃 **Ultra Lightweight:** Clean code with zero impact on proxy performance. * ⚙️ **Dual Compatibility:** Works flawlessly on both BungeeCord and Velocity using the same `.jar`. * 🔄 **Customizable Messages:** Fully customizable responses with MiniMessage `` and legacy `&c` support. --- ## 🧩 Commands & Permissions | Command | Aliases | Function | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/hub` | `/lobby`, `/leave` | Teleports the player to a hub server | `hubcommand.use` | | `/hub reload` | | Reloads the plugin messages and permissions | `hubcommand.admin` | > ⚠️ **WARNING:** > **Command Aliases:** You can add as many aliases as you want in the `config.yml`, but you **must completely restart the proxy** for new commands to be registered. The `/hub reload` command only updates messages and permissions. --- ## 🛡️ Why choose QL-HubCommand? 1. **Intelligent Routing:** Unlike standard fallback commands, our algorithm actively pings the servers to prevent sending players to dead lobbies. 2. **Easy to Use:** Out-of-the-box functionality with simple configuration. 3. **Cross-Platform:** No need to download different versions for BungeeCord or Velocity. 4. **Active Support:** Developed by **EsMoky**, ensuring standard quality and maintenance. --- ## 📥 Quick Installation > 🛑 **CAUTION:** > **Requirements:** Ensure your proxy is running **Java 17** or higher. 1. Download the version 1.0.0 `.jar` file. 2. Drop it into your `plugins/` folder of your BungeeCord or Velocity proxy. 3. Start your proxy and enjoy! 4. Configure your hub servers and messages in `plugins/QL-HubCommand/config.yml`. --- ## 💬 Support & Community If you need help, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature, join our Discord server! [**👉 Join our Discord Server**](https://discord.com/invite/ZRe3RnubdW)
